thesis: CRCT is a real fundamental re-rating that is digesting its post-earnings gap constructively. Q3 revenue turned up after two weak quarters, net income grew faster than revenue, and the balance sheet is net cash with low dilution risk. The price holds above all key moving averages in a tight 8.09-9.70 range on fading volume, and the pullback entry zone of 8.50-8.74 has a defined stop at 8.00. The case is modest, not strong. R/R is below 2, the stock is extended, insiders are selling, and the regime is risk-off, so this is a small, disciplined position at best.
